name: canli-mcp
description: Finance research and quantitative analysis through one Canli MCP connection.

packs.title: Enabled finance packs
packs.description: Comma-separated packs: quant, validation, fundamentals, research, backtest, markets. Paper trading can be added with your paper credentials.

paper_key_id.title: Optional Alpaca paper key ID
paper_key_id.description: For your paper account; add paper to Enabled finance packs to use it.

paper_secret_key.title: Optional Alpaca paper secret
paper_secret_key.description: Your paper account's secret, stored in the local client's configuration.

offline.title: Offline mode
offline.description: Enable only local quant and validation tools; market-data packs stay disabled.
